fact_text: Headline inflation peaked at about 38% in 2023, and food inflation reached about 50% that year, according to a finance adviser interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Headline inflation fell to about 4.5% in FY25 (July 2024 to June 2025), after the 2023 peak, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: In May 2023 inflation averaged about 35% across Nigeria, Turkey, Egypt and Argentina, close to Pakistan's 38% at that time, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: At publication the adviser put inflation at roughly 2-4%, and said the drop came from policy steps and easing international prices.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The adviser framed the economy in four areas: fiscal, monetary (interest rates and credit), external (trade, remittances, investment) and real sector (output, jobs, impact finance).
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The adviser's reform targets are private-sector and export-led growth, sustainable high GDP growth, optimised public finances, and lower climate and population risks.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The adviser named four structural reforms: tax, tariff, state-owned enterprise (SOE) and energy reform.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Public finance reform priorities cited are pensions, debt servicing, privatisation and SOE losses, plus access to finance.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Tax policy-making was moved from the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) to the Finance Ministry, separating policy from revenue collection, with implementation from June-July 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The adviser said tax should be set on economic value rather than on revenue needs, because tax changes behaviour and can steer investment toward chosen sectors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Tax-to-GDP ratio rose to 10.24% in FY25, a 25-year high, from about 8.8% in the year before.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The FBR collected about Rs 12 trillion in FY25, and the adviser said the year's extra collection came mainly from enforcement and compliance.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Enforcement and compliance added roughly Rs 800-850 billion to FY25 tax collection, the adviser said, against the prior year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: New tax safeguards allow arrest only in cases of about Rs 50 million (5 crore) or more, after three ignored notices and a court warrant, with the accused brought before a special judge within 24 hours.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Tax reforms include e-invoicing, track-and-trace and faceless processes, which the adviser said make filing simpler for salaried taxpayers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The FY26 budget cut the super tax on corporate income, which the adviser presented as a direction change toward lower rates.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Pakistan's income tax rates were described as reaching 40-60% for some incomes, which the adviser linked to low collections on a narrow base.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Raising tax rates without widening the base can reduce collections, a view the adviser attributed to tax experts he consulted.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: All four provinces legislated agricultural income tax under the National Fiscal Pact, which the adviser presented as meeting an IMF structural benchmark.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Provinces raise about 3% of GDP in their own taxes, and the adviser said neighbouring countries' provinces raise 5-6% of GDP.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The federal government passes more than half of its tax revenue to provinces, and provinces return their surpluses, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Most property tax revenue sits with provinces, while capital gains tax is federal, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Arhtis (agricultural middlemen) finance farmers, supply inputs, provide space and sell produce, and the adviser said bringing them into the tax system is a goal.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Informal farm lenders charge rates reported at 50% to several hundred percent, which the adviser said formal agricultural finance aims to displace.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Agricultural finance outstanding reached about Rs 2.5 trillion, adding about Rs 300 billion (38%) in FY25, with 9% more farmers borrowing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: New SME loans rose about 42% to about Rs 690 billion in FY25, and new SME borrowers rose about 55%, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: A small-home mortgage finance scheme was launched and funded in the FY26 budget, the adviser said, to extend housing finance to smaller buyers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The government is pushing finance for women-led businesses and startups, the adviser said, but gave no figures.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: A committee of businessmen and FBR officials was set up to settle sales tax disputes, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Retail, wholesale and trade is about 20% of an economy of about $400 billion, or roughly $80-85 billion, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The Prime Minister issued an instruction about one and a half months before publication requiring point-of-sale (POS) machines in every shop, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The informal economy is put at 30-40% of activity, and the adviser said past policies encouraged more people to keep cash outside the system.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The federal government has 43 ministries and over 400 departments, and rightsizing is being done in eight waves of about five ministries each, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Staff moved to the surplus pool keep receiving pay while not working, which the adviser said is a civil service reform problem.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The federal government holds about 215-216 state-owned enterprises, of which 85 are commercial, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: A reform implementation unit under the Prime Minister oversees reforms, with the finance minister leading an economic team of seven or eight members, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The adviser said reform results take one to three years to show, and warned that reforms have been reversed when governments changed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Three major rating agencies moved Pakistan's outlook to positive, the adviser said, and bonds trade at a premium.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The rupee has been stable for about 15 months at publication, the adviser said, which limits imported inflation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Oil prices hit an all-time high in 2022 during the Russia-Ukraine war, and rupee depreciation and floods pushed inflation sharply higher that year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The adviser said the IMF second review mission is due in late September 2025 and that most review benchmarks are met, with the review not yet concluded.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Gas sector circular debt is being addressed under an IMF-linked plan, with several models including dividend-related options still under discussion, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Refineries face a sales tax mismatch: inputs are taxed while petrol and diesel carry no sales tax, causing liquidity stress, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: About $5-6 billion of refinery investment is on hold over unresolved sales tax issues, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: A short-term fix moved part of the petrol price equalisation margin to refiners for liquidity, and a brownfield and industrial policy is expected to address refining investment, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The PIA privatisation transaction is planned for November-December 2025, with UK and Paris route deal-breakers removed, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Three power distribution companies (DISCOs) are in the privatisation pipeline, which the adviser said the energy team has prepared for investors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Three banks, including an agriculture bank and a women's bank, are in the privatisation pipeline, the adviser said, with talks under way.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Seven parties have reportedly engaged on the sale of a Pakistan-owned New York hotel, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The sale of House Building Finance Company is progressing, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Investors buying a distribution company or airline need the sector's own reforms done first, the adviser argued.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Initial official estimates put damage to the rice crop from the 2025 floods below 10%, and rice is described as a bumper crop.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The adviser called claims of 60-70% crop loss exaggerated and said official damage assessments were still pending.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The adviser said the 2025 floods were far smaller than the historic 2022 floods, and water levels were falling.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Government wheat stock is in place and flood damage to the wheat crop is limited, so the adviser said flour prices should not rise because of the floods.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Cotton arrivals fell after mid-September 2025 because of the floods, the adviser said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: The adviser expected food to be the main upside risk to inflation, with import pressure lower than in 2022 because oil prices have eased.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)

fact_text: Farmers often rely on informal lenders, where the speaker cited interest rates of 50%, 100% or even 500%, which he called loan sharking.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Industries Are Set to Get Competitive Energy Tariff In New Policy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-25)
